The Bihar School Examination Board is a government organization responsible for conducting exams and providing education in the state of Bihar.

For more information, visit the official website of the Bihar School Examination Board.

About the Programme

The BSEB DELED programme is a diploma course in elementary education.

The programme is designed to provide training to students who want to become teachers in elementary schools.
